rules.title: Protected asset physically accessible while all authorized custodians are absent

sources.act: Applicable bank custody policy — not supplied
sources.paragraph: Item-specific custody requirement and duration, if any
sources.verification_evidence: User requested unattended-asset review. No universal statutory N-second deadline verified; policy-based candidates require a separately verified item policy.

applicability_assumptions: Known item type and item-specific custody requirement are required. Unknown/personal bags are not assumed to contain cash.
All authorized custodians, not just the usual cashier, must be absent from the mapped custody area.
Missing person detections, an empty chair, camera blind spots and occlusion do not prove absence.
Laptop physical-custody observation does not prove an unlocked session.
Without verified bank policy, emit observational review with insufficient_evidence.
rules.threshold_basis: Project observation parameter only; replace with actual item-specific bank policy threshold if supplied.

rules.title: Cashier exits while protected items remain and door is open or verified unlocked

sources.paragraph: Confirmed room exit + protected items remain + open or independently verified unlocked door
sources.verification_evidence: Trusted delegated clarification: user explicitly confirmed this combined condition. No.14 structural closable/lockable-door provisions are not asserted to prohibit every transient open door.

applicability_assumptions: Actual room threshold crossing, not merely leaving the frame.
Verified room, door map, protected item classification, custody requirement and policy applicability.
Another authorized custodian can satisfy custody; ordinary bags and unknown contents are not assumed cash.
Door closed does not imply locked; lock hidden or unknown means uncertainty.
All candidates are project security review, not automatic statutory violations.
rules.threshold_basis: Project observation parameter; no statutory unattended interval.
